summary: Iter 34 (BB FM Kigali live audio streaming wiring) — all backend + frontend checks GREEN. Wrote 9 pytest cases in test_iter34_radio_stream.py: GET /api/radio/now-playing returns 200 with streamUrl='http://radio.bbkigali.com:8080/stream', streamUrlHttps=null (RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS not set in env — as expected), showTitle='BB FM Kigali Live', isLive=true, and all required playback + metadata fields present (streamUrl, streamUrlHttps, showTitle, djName, description, coverImage, youtubeVideoId, youtubeEmbedUrl, youtubeWatchUrl). Confirmed no MongoDB _id / internal 'key' leak. Static code inspection confirms server.py reads RADIO_STREAM_URL + RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS env vars and defines BB_KIGALI_STREAM constant. Migrate-on-boot logic (server.py:3982-3998) correctly updates existing radio_state row to the new streamUrl on redeploy (idempotent). Frontend: PlayerProvider mounts without errors, mini-player renders with 'BB FM Kigali Live' from now-playing, tapping mini-player-toggle actually invokes createAudioPlayer → play() (verified via outbound network request to radio.bbkigali.com:8080/stream captured in browser); no JS runtime exceptions / red screen. Browser auto-upgrades http→https for the mixed-content stream URL causing ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED — network-level behaviour, not a code bug (matches iter 34 review note). app.json has iOS UIBackgroundModes=['audio'], NSAppTransportSecurity.NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInMedia=true with radio.bbkigali.com exception (NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads=true, NSIncludesSubdomains=true, NSExceptionMinimumTLSVersion=TLSv1.0), Android usesCleartextTraffic=true, FOREGROUND_SERVICE + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permissions, expo-audio plugin listed, expo-av NOT used.

integration_issues.flow: Web radio playback (HTTPS page → HTTP stream)
integration_issues.issue: On HTTPS web, Chrome auto-upgrades the http://radio.bbkigali.com:8080/stream URL to https:// (which the stream server doesn't support on port 8080) and the request fails with ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED / 'no supported source found'. This is expected — the code fallback logic in pickStreamUrl() already prefers streamUrlHttps on HTTPS pages, but RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS env var is not configured server-side. Native iOS/Android will work correctly via the ATS/cleartext exceptions. To fully enable web playback, set RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS in backend/.env to an HTTPS-fronted mirror (Cloudflare/CDN in front of the Icecast source). Not a code bug — pure infra configuration.

action_items: OPTIONAL infra: configure RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS env var in backend/.env with an HTTPS-fronted mirror (e.g. Cloudflare CDN or Nginx TLS termination in front of radio.bbkigali.com:8080/stream) so the Expo web build can actually stream audio without mixed-content blocking. Native iOS/Android already work via ATS/cleartext exceptions.

OPTIONAL: consider changing the default coverImage URL — YouTube maxresdefault.jpg 404s in browser console (Failed to load resource: 404) whenever the current live broadcast has no HD thumbnail. Falling back to hqdefault.jpg would silence this.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerProvider correctly guards player.replace() with try/catch so a live streamUrl swap in admin CMS won't crash the player.

pickStreamUrl(np) correctly prefers streamUrlHttps only when Platform.OS==='web' AND window.location.protocol==='https:'. Native builds always get the HTTP URL which is fine because of ATS/cleartext exceptions in app.json.

setAudioModeAsync({shouldPlayInBackground:true, playsInSilentMode:true, interruptionMode:'duckOthers'}) matches the Android FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK + iOS UIBackgroundModes:['audio'] permissions — background playback should work end-to-end in native builds.
Migrate-on-boot in server.py:3982-3998 correctly upserts the new streamUrl into an existing radio_state row via update_one — idempotent and picks up new URLs after a redeploy.
expo-av is not imported anywhere (confirmed via grep) — only expo-audio + expo-video are used. Compliant with Expo SDK 54 deprecation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PlayerProvider mounts + play invocation verified end-to-end, no runtime errors, app.json permissions all correct)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now serves the real BB Kigali stream URL and expo-audio is wired up on the frontend. Any 'actual playback stopped/errored' issues on web are due to the HTTP-only stream server + mixed-content auto-upgrade — NOT a frontend code bug. To fully enable web playback set RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS in backend/.env to a TLS-fronted mirror. Native iOS/Android streaming should work in a real device build via the ATS + cleartext exceptions already in app.json. When testing background/locked-screen audio you MUST use a native build (not Expo Go web preview). Also: the coverImage YouTube maxresdefault.jpg URL occasionally 404s — cosmetic only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. The one observed 'net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED' on browser play attempt is expected: Chrome auto-upgraded the HTTP stream URL to HTTPS on the HTTPS page; the Icecast server on port 8080 doesn't answer TLS, so the socket closed. Not reproducible in native iOS/Android builds where the HTTP URL is used directly with the ATS exception.
